patches.reason: Cache credentials by bytes, use a total ordering consistent with equality, and bound UDP crypto cache to 4096 entries. Initialize UDP padding before encryption to prevent reused/uninitialized buffer disclosure.
Initialize client TCP padding before encryption rather than exposing uninitialized buffer bytes.
Initialize request serializer padding before publishing bytes through BufMut.

Use pinned local shadowsocks-crypto 0.6.2 fork, which adds the original panel AES192GCM and XChaCha20 methods. Original crypto sources and license are in crypto/UPSTREAM.json and crypto/LICENSE. Remove tcp/tcp_tfo/udp test target registrations whose upstream test files are absent from this narrow vendor package; the upstream test suite is not claimed as run.

crypto_dependency.scope: Crypto helpers only; fork adds AES192GCM and XChaCha20 legacy stream. No TLS/listener/resolver/TUN/FFI runtime.
